Existing local analyst browser rejects unique-ID, deterministic sort, top-ten completeness, unmapped count, mapped-count upper bounds and overlapping tag-count contradictions.

Missing mitre data still returns untagged source diagnostic and does not invent a source technique.
Node analyst view rejects repeated IDs even when count differs, order/tie anomalies, nonexistent top-ten entries, impossible mapped alert vs tag counts and extra source metadata.
Node analyst view accepts legitimate multiple source labels on one alert, whose count sum can exceed imported alert count.
Existing Linux race, Go coverage+vet, Node UI and platform CI pass at exact HEAD, engineering mandatory security checks unchanged.
